item.title: Majority Element
item.description: Learn how to solve the Majority Element problem from LeetCode using Python and the Boyer-Moore Voting Algorithm. Ideal for coding interviews.

item.title: Pierre Munhoz — Data Engineering, Analytics & More
item.description: Discover the engineering blog of Pierre Munhoz, a freelance Data Engineer. Explore insights on data engineering, analytics, and coding.

item.title: How to backup Airbyte on Google Cloud Storage?
item.description: I found on the airbyte forum how to backup the Airbyte instance to a new instance but I also used this resource to create a backup script of Airbyte.

item.title: What is Boyer-Moore majority vote algorithm?
item.description: Boyer–Moore majority vote algorithm The Boyer-Moore voting algorithm is a clever method to find the majority element in an array (an element that appears more than n/2 times) using O(1) space and O(n) time.

item.title: BigQuery Column-Level Security: Complete Guide to Data Masking & PII Protection
item.description: Learn how to implement BigQuery Column-Level Security and Dynamic Data Masking to protect PII using Terraform, dbt and IAM without duplicating tables.

item.title: dbt Defer: Speed Up CI/CD Pipelines and Slash Compute Costs by 75%
item.description: Learn how dbt defer optimizes CI/CD pipelines by building only changed models. Complete guide with real examples showing 75% faster builds, GitLab/GitHub Actions configs, and a hands-on demo repository.

item.title: Data Lakes vs Data Warehouses vs Lakehouses: A Complete Guide with Examples
item.description: Explore the evolution from data warehouses to data lakes and lakehouses. Learn the differences, when to use each architecture, and see practical examples with Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, and PySpark code.

item.title: Data File Formats for Data Engineering: CSV, JSON, Parquet, Avro, and More
item.description: A practical data engineering guide to choosing file formats for ingestion, storage, and analytics, with trade-offs and real-world examples.

item.title: Building a €100/month Modern Data Stack with GCP, dbt & Dagster
item.description: Learn how I built a production-grade modern data stack for €100/month using self-hosted Airbyte, Dagster, dbt Core and BigQuery. Complete architecture guide with Terraform IaC, CI/CD best practices, and cost optimization strategies for HRIS SaaS companies.
